summary: Itaú Unibanco Holding S.A. furnished a Form 6-K on November 6, 2026, attaching its condensed consolidated interim financial statements prepared under IFRS (IAS 34) for the period ended September 30, 2026, together with an independent auditor's review report. The filing contains no transaction, ownership change, or corporate action; it is a routine foreign-private-issuer periodic earnings disclosure equivalent to a US quarterly report on Form 10-Q. No terms, board recommendation, advisors, or structural mechanics are stated. The risk-arb angle is nil; this is informational only for credit and equity analysts tracking the bank's third-quarter results.
